instruction: PART 6: Use the word in parentheses at the end of each sentence to form a word that fits in the blanks.

items.questionText: 1. Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit _______ to help in their work. (VOLUNTARILY)
2. I’m very _______ of your new coat. It’s beautiful! (ENVY)
3. It was _______ that 40% of patients had high blood pressure. (OBSERVATION)
4. It would be seriously _______ to suggest that television has no effect on children. (MISLEAD)
5. He gave a/an _______ talk on overcoming obstacles in life. (INSPIRE)
6. The university’s _______ of the new scheduling system led to some confusion. (IMPLEMENT)
7. He has had a long and _______ career in medicine. (DISTINGUISH)
8. Her husband had been _______ her for years. (DECEPTION)
9. The use of animals in scientific tests raises difficult _______ questions. (ETHICS)
10. Alcohol is strictly _______ in Saudi Arabia. (FORBID)

instruction: Part 8: Ask and answer the following questions in pairs taking turns or write an answer using a complete sentence.
